run.title: GPT-5.4-mini memory-model validation
run.goal: Validate GPT-5.4-mini as the modern fast memory-building model while keeping GPT-5.4 for answer paths.

dataset.name: LongMemEval-S targeted sessions
dataset.selection_strategy: Rerun the same two targeted sessions used in the pipeline-improvement validation.

scoring.method: targeted operational validation plus one readback query
scoring.notes: This is not an official LongMemEval score. It validates ingest success, latency, telemetry, and one fact-backed readback answer.

quality.supporting_fact: The user has already bought five tops from H&M.

caveats: Only two targeted sessions were run; this is not a full benchmark.
GPT-5.4-mini made more calls and produced more embedded items than GPT-4o-mini-memory on the same sessions.
More extracted memory may be richer or noisier; quality impact requires scored batch evaluation.
Summarization-specific routing remains partly unverified because internal worker paths often use the default model name.
next_gate: Run a small 3-case LongMemEval batch with official or LLM-judge scoring and compare GPT-5.4-mini-memory against GPT-4o-mini-memory.
